# FG-GIT-0021

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 413 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | [`push-checks`](../../ops/runbooks/push-checks.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_push_with_a_large_file_is_refused_with_fg_git_0021` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: プッシュに上限より大きいファイルが含まれていたため、プッシュ全体を拒否しました。ファイルを履歴から取り除いてからもう一度プッシュしてください。
- en: The push contained a file larger than the limit, so the whole push was refused. Remove the file from the history and push again.
- id: Push berisi berkas yang lebih besar dari batas, sehingga seluruh push ditolak. Hapus berkas itu dari riwayat lalu push lagi.

## 原因 (cause)

The pre-receive hook (`forge hook pre-receive`, M3 X8, ADR-0008 amendment X8) found a blob larger than `git.http.push_max_blob_bytes` (default 100 MiB) among the objects the push brings. The size check reads every object git received for the push (the quarantine's own object directory, streamed: `cat-file --batch-all-objects`), so it is complete whatever the push contains — a blob only an annotated tag names, or one hidden behind padding that stops the secret scan early, is sized all the same; a size check that cannot finish refuses the push (FG-GIT-0023 `size_check_failed`). git refused the whole push (`ng <ref> pre-receive hook declined` for every ref); the quarantined objects are discarded, no ref changed. A blob already in the repository never trips the check.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The pusher's terminal shows `remote: FG-GIT-0021 …` with one line per file: its path, its size, the limit and the commit that adds it (never the content). One info log line with `error_code`, `request_id` and in `context`: `event=forge.git.push_checked`, `verdict=refused`, `findings`, `rules`, `first_rule=large_blob`, `first_path`, `first_blob`, `first_commit`, `objects`, `repo_id`. Read-only on the pusher's side: `git rev-list --objects <commit> --not --remotes | git cat-file --batch-check='%(objectsize) %(rest)' | sort -n | tail`.

## 対処 (fix)

The pusher removes the file from the commits not yet pushed (`git rm --cached <path>` and `git commit --amend`, or `git rebase -i` / `git filter-repo` for an older commit) and pushes again; large binary content belongs in an artifact store, not in git. When the file is legitimate, an administrator raises `git.http.push_max_blob_bytes` (configuration, restart) — runbook push-checks.
